selection.roadmapLane: P1-A concrete account/frontier/balance preparation with original-quote sequencing; separate from actual SDK/work/signing/runtime and official-x402 recovery.
selection.basis: The opt-in v3 reader obtains AccountInfo from the closed exchange but exposes caller-supplied per-stage plans. This new one-attempt owner retains the original quote and assembled block and removes later plan/block replacement from its API. Reuse the existing captured reader and DATA stages rather than replacing them.
selection.finiteChange: Three new opt-in source modules, two authored entries, one preserved failed-reader record and this new success record. Existing main source, tests, outcomes, packages, workflows, profiles, journals and payment identities are unchanged.

implementation.input: Only explicit v3 UNSIGNED selected read DATA, no supplied accountInfoResultJson. Later APIs accept no caller plan, quote or block. assemble accepts only existing supplied material DATA in addition to read input.
sequence: Create work request against that same original quote with fresh bracketed AccountInfo
Assemble once using fixed supplied publicKey/nonce DATA against the original quote
Validate that SAME retained unsigned block with fresh bracketed account/balance/DP reads
implementation.lifetime: One volatile ordered attempt. Busy/held precede inspection. Admitted failure permanently holds even before a read. Wrong arity/order does not consume the next legal stage. No reset/requote/reassembly/fallback/native close or cancellation.
implementation.budget: Reuse the same32-handoff account wire behind the ten-cycle reader bound. Three account handoffs per completed stage; at most10 cycles. Further retained-block validations consume that same budget, then hold without counter recreation.
implementation.unchanged: Previous v1/v2 readers, v2 attempt, supplied/deferred planners, active buyer, SDK path, signer, native HTTPS/RPC owners and all payment/recovery identities.
implementation.authorityBoundary: Original-quote sequencing is not durable custody, consumed authority or signing permission. UNSIGNED and coherent AccountInfo/DP/runtime/policy replies remain declared DATA. External signing cannot be detected here; stop this API before signing. A new instance grants no replacement/re-signing right.
implementation.readBoundary: AccountInfo lacks chain ID/block hash. Height equality plus frontier bracketing does not establish authentic/current funds, spendability, atomicity, ancestry or absence of ABA changes.
implementation.adoptionBoundary: No active planner/SDK/native owner is cut over. The pending actual nonce-search/material drafts remain excluded, unchanged and unexecuted.
